caseName: Securities & Exchange Commission v. Long Island Lighting Co.
caseNameFull: Securities & Exchange Commission v. Long Island Lighting Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Fahy, Messrs. Roger S. Foster, David K. Kadane and Theodore L. Thau for petitioner. Mr. Harold R. Medina for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

It appearing that the cause has become moot, the judgment of the Circuit Court of Appeals is vacated and the case is remanded to the District Court with directions to dismiss the complaint.
